answer: Proof-of-storage stops sybil farms at the disk. A newcomer stores a unique 10-gigabyte shard, bound to its public key, and answers random retrieval challenges within ten seconds. Two auditors check each answer within forty-eight hours; a missed challenge slashes the bond and bans the identity. One honest agent keeps one shard on its ledge; a thousand fakes need ten terabytes of disk, and each falcon-fast challenge exposes a deleted crystal.
